subject: Stressproof validation milestone: onboarding run & evidence transfer
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@solahealth.com>, SolaHealth Ops <ops@solahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Sep 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Stressproof validation milestone: onboarding run & evidence transfer

Hi Alice / SolaHealth ops team,

Per our onboarding checklist I want to lock in the stressproof validation run for the initial integration milestone. Our goals for this run (baseline acceptance test):
- Sustained throughput: 1,200 req/s (2-minute sustained windows)
- p95 latency target: <= 250 ms
- p99 latency target: <= 500 ms
- Error rate: < 0.5% (5xx/timeouts) during steady-state

Proposed schedule:
- Warm-up and canary ramp: 09/03 09:00-09:30 PT
- Full sustained runs (3 x 2-minute steady windows): 09/03 10:00-11:00 PT

What we'll need from your side:
- A sample traffic mix (payloads) and token distribution — if you can attach a 5–10 minute sample it helps tune the sequence lengths.
- Test accounts/ingress endpoints or a DNS allowlist to target Redwood Dedicated staging.

I attached the run checklist and a JMeter template to this thread. We'll capture token throughput, tail latencies (p50/p95/p99), GPU utilization, and error traces; we'll provide a consolidated CSV and dashboard snapshots after the run.

If these targets look off for you, call them out now — otherwise we’ll proceed with the schedule and loop in the SRE/CS leads.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]
Attachments: initial-run-instructions.md, jmeter-template.jmx

Thanks — those targets look reasonable to start with. A couple quick clarifications:
1) Traffic profile: we'll send a 6-minute sample that reflects real mix (70% short prompts, 30% multi-turn). See attached sample_payloads.json.

3) Data masking: some prompts contain PII — we'll provide scrubbed versions for the public run; full dataset can be provided in a secure S3 location if needed.

We prefer the run to happen between 09:00-11:00 PT on 09/03. If you need a longer warm-up, let us know.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Alice Nguyen <alice@solahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 Sep 2028 14:47:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Stressproof validation milestone: onboarding run & evidence transfer

Thanks — quick tech plan and acceptance checklist from SRE side (TL;DR: we'll run from Redwood Dedicated staging with telemetry capture).

Test harness: JMeter (template attached) + custom load-script.sh for concurrency control. We'll run three passes:
- Pass A (smoke): 1 minute ramp to 200 req/s, sanity checks
- Pass B (ramp): linear ramp from 200 -> 1,200 req/s over 10 minutes, 2-minute sustained at 1,200
- Pass C (stress + recovery): burst to 1,500 req/s for 30s, then recovery to baseline

Pre-run config:
- Disable prefix KV cache for the first full-pass to observe cold-path latencies.
- Warm-up tokens: 300k (approx) to populate common kernels.
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 request latency, token throughput (tokens/sec), GPU utilization, host CPU, memory, 5xx/error traces, retry counts.
- Sampling: stack traces on any request > 750ms.

Artifacts we'll produce:
- results-20280903.csv (per-request latencies + meta)
- Grafana snapshots (per-model and per-inference-host)
- Aggregated dashboard with p95/p99 over time and error rates

Attached: load-script.sh (simple wrapper around JMeter) and the JMeter template you already have. We'll place results in the shared run bucket and notify when artifacts are ready.

If SolaHealth ops prefers a different ramp profile, we can adjust. Otherwise we'll execute 09/03 09:00 PT.

- Karthik
SRE, Redwood Inference
Attachment: load-script.sh

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@solahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Sep 2028 16:02:05 -0700
Subject: Run results and sign-off request — SolaHealth stressproof validation (09/03)

Hi Alice, team —

We completed the three-pass run per the plan. Summary findings below (full artifacts attached):
- Sustained throughput: median across windows 1,220 req/s (target 1,200 req/s)
- p95 latency: 210 ms (target <=250 ms)
- p99 latency: 480 ms (target <=500 ms)
- Peak burst: brief spike to 1,480 req/s; during the 30s burst we observed a 0.9% increase in 5xxs, primarily timeouts to an upstream enrichment service (SolaHealth side).
- Token throughput: 125k tokens/sec during sustained windows
- GPU utilization: steady 72-88% across hosts during steady windows
- Retries: automated client retries masked ~0.2% of total requests

Attachments included: results-20280903.csv (per-request), grafana_snapshot_20280903.png (dashboard snapshots).

Recommendations / next steps:
1) SolaHealth ops: please validate that the upstream enrichment service observed the same timeouts during the burst — we saw most 5xx traces include downstream 504s.
2) We can enable a lightweight prefix-KV for production to reduce p50 by ~10–15% if desired; Marcus can provide a quantization/recommendation if you want to trade accuracy for lower tail latency.
3) If you accept this evidence as meeting the milestone, please reply with a brief sign-off and we'll mark the onboarding milestone complete in HubSpot (deal HL-7890).

Thanks everyone — happy to jump on a 15-minute readout if useful.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
Attachments: results-20280903.csv, grafana_snapshot_20280903.png
